name: mongodb
customAptRepoCommands: echo 'deb [ arch=amd64,arm64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.gpg ] https://repo.mongodb.org/apt/ubuntu noble/mongodb-org/8.0 multiverse' | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mongodb-org-8.0.list

backup.name: mongo-data
backup.path: STRING=$(cat /etc/systemd/system/wallet.service | grep MONGO_STRING | cut -d'=' -f3- | cut -d"'" -f1); mongodump --uri=$STRING --out="$BACKUP_PATH/mongodb/mongo-data"

preRestore.name: Start mongod service temporarily with default config to upload backup

postRestore.name: Enable and restart mongoDb
postRestore.command: systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl start mongod; systemctl enable --now mongod
